topic.title: What if the Strait of Hormuz closed?

shape.name: The domino
shape.beats: hook: one place on the map shuts -> the scale of what passes it -> day by day, one place after another feels it, each on the map -> the twist (the one who could shut it needs it too) -> the payoff -> loop
shape.why: a what-if whose consequences spread outward place by place from one point on the map, told as a day counter

title: Hormuz shuts for a week. Who runs out first?
description:
The Strait of Hormuz shuts for a week: which country runs out first?
The Strait of Hormuz, the gap of sea between Iran and Oman, and the countries behind it, day by day on the map.
Sources: US Energy Information Administration (Mar 2026). The characters are not advisers.
Maps simplified. Borders as recognised by the country each video is about.
